rationale: The previous candidate cautiously reduced base_speed to 0.9, increased ki to 1.5, and lowered kd to 1.0 to improve stability and reduce stalling on the slalom track, but stalling persisted. The evaluator feedback suggests further reducing kd to 0.5 to smooth steering oscillations, increasing ki to 2.0 to better correct steady-state errors and reduce line loss events, and lowering base_speed to 0.8 to enhance stability and prevent stalls. I retain the stable geometry and sensor layout, which have supported consistent line tracking. The line loss strategy remains 'last_direction' as it has helped reduce stalls previously. I continue to request measurements of completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, max_error, line_loss_events, and steering_oscillation to monitor improvements. I expect these changes to reduce stalling on the slalom track, lower rms_error and line loss events, and smooth steering oscillations, leading to better finish rates and overall performance.
